profiles.name: Matbali Musah
profiles.description: Matbali Musah represents Sipitang, Sabah, in the Dewan Rakyat. Parliament records affiliation with Gabungan Rakyat Sabah (GRS).
profiles.affiliation_note: Parliament’s current GRS coalition label is retained. Service addresses, event attendance and earlier Bersatu membership are not used to assign a current component party. No court judgment is converted into a delivery milestone.

milestones.title: Study the feasibility of a National Entrepreneur Repository
milestones.description: Mohamad Alamin announced a 2026 feasibility study to examine integrating KUSKOP agency databases into a central entrepreneur-data hub.
milestones.progress_note: The undertaking is specific to the feasibility study. A completed study, approved nationwide repository, launch date and numerical progress were not established. Earlier SMEIPA programme totals do not measure this new study.

milestones.title: Lead the Malaysian THAIFEX trade mission in Bangkok
milestones.description: The Malaysian embassy reported Alamin’s 25–29 May mission, including Malaysian pavilions, bilateral discussions and business-engagement sessions. The exhibition included 158 Malaysian exhibitors.
milestones.progress_note: Achieved covers the documented mission, not signed sales, realised exports or later investment. Multiple ministries and business groups contributed to the delegation.

milestones.title: Provide Christmas contributions to 45 Sindumin churches
milestones.description: A party report records Matbali and Sindumin representative Yusof Yacob jointly presenting support to ten larger and 35 smaller churches.
milestones.progress_note: This is a December 2024 report of an earlier handover, not a new November 2026 allocation. Achieved covers that joint contribution round only; recipient spending and future rounds were not verified.

methodology: Commitments, documented activities and limited delivery reports are distinct. Evidence-only records have no invented earlier promise. Achieved covers the described handover, programme session or launch only. Shared agency responsibility, historical dates, count units, source limitations and missing follow-up evidence are explicit. No claim of exhaustive research is made.
